image_description: A close-up, slightly angled view of a printed restaurant menu. The paper has a textured, off-white appearance. The text is arranged in columns with item names on the left and prices on the right. However, the text itself is illegible gibberish, resembling a distorted font or AI-generated hallucination of letters rather than real words. There are decorative illustrative elements at the top (possibly food items like bread or pastries) that appear somewhat melted or indistinct. The lighting is soft, casting slight shadows, suggesting a physical object, but the typography lacks structural integrity.
